content: We found that 25.84% of Dutch, 21.76% of Turkish, 24.46% Spanish, and 10.71% of Russian reviews that were misclassified had non-English words in them. These non-English words might be causing the misclassifications. However, a large portion of the missclassifications is not caused due to not-translated words. At the end, the machine translation errors has some but not noticeable effects on our model. Therefore, we can claim that machine translation preserves most of the information necessary for sentiment analysis.
